finding.message: The `process` function can raise exceptions but the result is used without error handling.
finding.failure_scenario: When `process new_value` raises, the main flow terminates before returning a fallback result, so this PR can turn bad input into an uncaught exception.
finding.why_now: This PR changed the call site to use `process new_value` directly, so the new call needs an exception boundary here.
finding.suggested_fix:
match process new_value with
| exception exn -> log_error exn; 0
| result -> result
